notes.title: Early Access Patch 0.2.0
notes.notes:
Greetings, Agent!

I hope you enjoy version 0.2.0 of Heist.exe in Early Access. For a full list of changes to the game, please visit the most recent announcement [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3749980/view/497204020946927850]at this link[/url].

Good luck out there!

notes.title: Early Access Version 0.2.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [p]Greetings, Agents![/p][p][/p][p]On August 15, 2025, a new version of Heist.exe will be released. This update focuses mainly on visual changes, such as to the game's levels and fonts. Additionally, I've made some audio and gameplay changes to improve your play experience. [b]Please note that after this update, the game will still be in Early Access and no major content has been added.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]For more information on what's been updated, please review the notes below.[/p][p][/p][h1]Patch Notes[/h1][p][/p][h2]Visual Changes[/h2][p]The following changes have been made to the game's visuals and aesthetics:[/p][list][*][p]The networks (levels) and various objects therein now contain new wireframe materials! These materials are meant to make the game's settings look like they're inside computer simulations. [/p][list][*][p]Some objects that have been changed include the walls surrounding the levels and most level art, like the display cases, large pyramids, large flower pots, and plants.[/p][/*][*][p]Most objects important for gameplay, such as Level Altering Machines (like the terminals and buttons), Translatable Walls, Scalable Blocks, and Possessions, do not have wireframes.[/p][list][*][p]The Checkpoints and Teleporters do boast wireframes to help them stand out more easily, but they otherwise look the same.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Changed the fonts of every type of text in the game. Dialogue coming from robotic characters or technological sources now boasts straighter text with minimal curves to it, while text coming from human characters or instructions is more rounded. Meanwhile, the text for the HUD now shares the User Interface's text font.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the materials on enemies to a red checkered pattern. The Patrolling Guards now have backpacks, too![/p][/*][*][p]The lighting in all rooms has been changed to be slightly brighter, and the floors now look bumpy reflect some light.[/p][/*][*][p]Glass is now slightly more opaque, making it easier to tell whether or not you are behind/below it.[/p][/*][*][p]Agent Tehsi (the player character) now has a green hat instead of a red one.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The overhaul in visuals has caused many rendering bugs to crop up. I will attempt to fix these bugs for a future update. I apologize for this inconvenience.[/p][p][/p][h2]Audio Changes[/h2][p]The following changes have been made to the game's audio:[/p][list][*][p]Certain objects no longer utilize Spatial Blend when playing audio, which should make the volume and pitch for sounds played by said objects more consistent.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the volume for several sounds and music tracks to better accommodate players who play with louder volume.[/p][list][*][p]This is meant to be a temporary solution to not having an Audio Slider. I intend to add one in a future update.[/p][/*][*][p]I will rebalance audio as needed based on player feedback.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Gameplay Changes[/h2][p]The following changes have been made to the gameplay experience:[/p][list][*][p]Increased the intensity of lights emitted by LAMs and NETBots to make them easier to see against the floors of each level.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the Possessions of each level to their respective Mission Briefings in attempt to add visual clarity to the player's objective.[/p][/*][*][p]Any wireframed objects that are now transparent will not block the sightlines of NETBots. This shouldn't change gameplay much in this update, but there may be fringe cases where players will be seen behind certain wireframed objects.[/p][/*][*][p]For Mission 1: The Archive Network:[/p][list][*][p]Removed the collision from the large pyramids in the facility to account for their change in material. They look like they can be walked through, so you can walk through them now![/p][/*][*][p]Added a Translatable Wall to the entrance connecting the first and second rooms to reduce confusion on where the player has to go during the Escape Sequence.[/p][list][*][p]This wall will ONLY appear after the first time the player picks up the Possession.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]For Mission 2: The Branch Network: [/p][list][*][p]In the first room, moved the Teleporter closer to the player's spawn point along with the wall behind it. This means the player now needs less time to reach the Teleporter during the Escape Sequence, and provides the player additional cover from the Spinning Sentry nearby.[/p][/*][*][p]The camera angle in the first room now switches slightly sooner moving away from the teleporter. Conversely, it switches slightly later moving towards the teleporter.[/p][/*][*][p]The upper and lower levels of the third room now have their own camera angles. The former has a static overhead view, while the latter has a side view that follows the player.[/p][/*][*][p]The ramp in the third room has been reoriented to face the left and right walls (originally faced the front and back). Additionally, this has opened up a new navigational option for the player.[/p][list][*][p]The path of the Patrolling Guard near the ramp has been adjusted to accommodate this change.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed the settings of the game's application window so players can now exit full screen by pressing [b]ALT+ENTER[/b] on the keyboard. While windowed, the player can resize the game window by clicking and dragging its edges.[/p][/*][*][p]Made other various bug fixes.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That's all, Agents. See you in Cyberspace![/p]

notes.title: AVAILABLE NOW
notes.notes: [p]Greetings, Agents![/p][p][/p][p]I'm happy to announce that Heist.exe is now available in Early Access! Also I wanted to say thank you for showing interest in the game, and for your patience. I hope what you're able to play in this release has been worth the wait.[/p][p][/p][p]Throughout the next few weeks, please stay tuned for updates to the game. They may range from small tweaks to major changes to aspects like gameplay or visuals. I can't promise anything specific right now, but in addition to the work that'll be done over the next few weeks, I would like to update the game throughout Early Access based on your feedback. Changes will be published through an announcement when a new version is available. Should you have any questions, please contact me at [url="https://purplehippoprod@gmail.com"]purplehippoprod@gmail.com[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]That's all, Agents! Now, go reclaim those possessions![/p]

notes.title: Heist.exe Early Access Delay
notes.notes: [p]Greetings, Agents![/p][p][/p][p]The Early Access release of Heist.exe has been put on hold until further notice. Why? Well unfortunately, for the third time Steam was unable to run the review build through the steam client. My attempts at fixing this issue failed.[/p][p][/p][p]I believe trust is built on honesty and transparency, so I'm unable to confirm a release date at this time. What I am able to do is take responsibility for not properly configuring the game's launch settings. BUT, with time--hopefully no more than a week or two--I will get this issue fixed, and the heist will begin in earnest! And once the review build gets approved, I [b]will[/b] hit the launch button and let you all know it's out.[/p][p][/p][p]As excited as I was to release the game today, there's nothing I can do besides fix the problem in front of me. Please wait a little longer until I'm able to fix it. Thank you for your patience.[/p][p][/p][p]That's all, Agents. Take care![/p]

notes.title: GCC Announcement and Early Access
notes.notes: [p]Greetings, Agents![/p][p][/p][p]As of the time you're reading this, Game Con Canada will likely have started. That means you can try out Heist.exe in the Indie expo ALL WEEKEND! So get ready for high-tension stealth gameplay and escapes you won't forget, because the Heist is ON. Of course, and regardless of whether you'll try the game out at GCC or not, I also hope you're raring to go for the [b]Early Access release at 11:59 PM, EDT[/b] (check your time zone accordingly)! [/p][p][/p][p]That's still the plan, at least; in getting the game's build reviewed, Steam has had trouble launching the game from the Steam client specifically. The game is being reviewed for the third time, and I'm pretty sure the problem has fixed. I should know by today, but even if I don't, I'll update you all accordingly. Please reach out to purplehippoprod@gmail.com if you have any questions.[/p][p][/p][p]That's all, agents. Let's bounce![/p]
